sources.snippet: Overview gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-uncensored-GGUF is a quantized version of an abliterated (uncensored) Gemma 4 model with 26 billion parameters, maintained by TrevorJS. The model removes refusal behavior through norm-preserving biprojected abliteration with Expert-Granular Abliteration (EGA) applied to MoE expert weights. It supports an 8192-token context window and runs on CPU or GPU through llama ...
